The comics from Suiton00's "season 2" of original comic strips. There's two in here. The first few images of the gallery (#1-#11) are the "normal"/base variation of each page, with the rest of the edits placed later so as to not break up the pace of the story.

Pg. 1-8 are the pages of the first comic
Pg. 9-11 are the pages of the second comic.

The images afterwards are the other variations of the comic pages, which is to say nude/erect/cum and textless versions.
